frequency_question: How often can all mandatory legal and procedural steps for an indefinite strike be fully executed within a 39-day window?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a major multi-union federation issued a strike notice or ballot resulting in an indefinite strike action within 39 days or less from the initial formal dispute declaration.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major historical attempts analyzed; all required regulatory timelines exceeding 45-60 days.
known_gaps: Emergency conciliation fast-tracking provisions occasionally shorten timelines by a few days under specific ministerial intervention.
skeleton: Statutory notice periods (minimum 14 to 42 days) + mandatory conciliation meetings (minimum 2 to 4 weeks) + strike ballot administration (14 days). Total minimum procedural time structurally exceeds a 39-day window when executed sequentially.
multiplier: Sequential statutory minimum requirements = ~56 days minimum process time / 39-day available window
validity_reason: Labor dispute statutes and statutory notice periods remain fixed barring legislative amendment.
